people.name: Benjamin Robbins Curtis
people.bio: US Supreme Court justice from 1851 to 1857
people.extract: Benjamin Robbins Curtis was an American lawyer and judge who served as an associate justice of the United States Supreme Court from 1851 to 1857. Curtis was the only Whig justice of the Supreme Court, and he was the first Supreme Court justice to have a formal law degree. He is often remembered as one of the two dissenters in the Supreme Court's infamous 1857 decision Dred Scott v. Sandford.
highlights: Only Whig justice on the Supreme Court.
Dissented in the 1857 Dred Scott v. Sandford decision.

people.name: Spyridon Marinatos
people.extract: Spyridon Marinatos was a Greek archaeologist who specialised in the Minoan and Mycenaean civilizations of the Aegean Bronze Age. He is best known for the excavation of the Minoan site of Akrotiri on Thera, which he conducted between 1967 and 1974. He received many honours in Greece and abroad, and was considered one of the most important Greek archaeologists of his day.
highlights: Greek archaeologist of Minoan and Mycenaean civilizations.
Excavated the Minoan site of Akrotiri on Thera.
Considered one of the most important Greek archaeologists.

people.name: Alexz Johnson
people.extract: Alexzandra Spencer Johnson is a Canadian actress, singer, songwriter, and musician. Known for her distinctive sound since her debut in 2010, her first album, Voodoo, was independently released with her brother, Brendan Johnson. Over the years, she has released several albums and EPs, including: The Basement Recordings series (2011–2013), Skipping Stone (2012) and her sophomore album Let 'Em Eat Cake (2014). She continued to evolve with subsequent albums A Stranger Time (2017), Still Alive (2020) and Seasons (2023).
highlights: Canadian actress, singer, songwriter, and musician.
Known for albums like "Let 'Em Eat Cake" and "Seasons.
